name: @researchos/ui-research-review
description: Phase 4 ui-research-review (v0.1): out-of-tree client package — a conversation chat node triggered by a user message keyword (综述/文献综述/review) that renders a review generation panel: topic input + paper checkboxes (from /research-paper/search) + generate button → POST /research-review/generate → polls the task until SUCCESS → shows the markdown review.
